scope: Actual saved DayHubCave #896 flower: named action UI, clock/sampling/skinning, packed pose IPC, native Vulkan geometry patches with material reuse, pause/stop/map switch and unchanged source. Bird/ray/crab resource sampling is separately tested; autonomous creature AI, Model/Barn lifecycle, mirrored/external packs, layered animations and original dynamic RSQRTSS are not claimed.

before.scope: Original terrain/skirt GLSL, real packed geometry/material textures with declared gamma/mip handling and supported anisotropy (16x preview request), recovered float32 shader time and three-layer scroll accumulation. Shared original Wind spatial/timer/order sampling, additional Marker OBBs and cached Rail equations feed original texture drift. Ambient/boundary/interaction force services and native Rail lifecycle remain pending. Shared float32 HDR color/depth and linear decal/skirt blending. Main material viewport feeds the cloud depth/FogUpsample/MotionGen/MotionDilate/TemporalAa/Tonemap chain. PNG area-filtered mip generation and anisotropy strength remain preview adapters, not original exporter/Metal parity. Scene probe, point lights/shadows, water/puddle, startup events, bloom/motion and original Metal per-draw half quantization remain pending. Resource models and prepared Beamo LOD0 draws use original GLSL, packed float3/color/SNORM normals/half4 UV pairs and baked lighting. Transparent descriptor states use original blend/depth/cull evidence; back-to-front bounds ordering is an editor adapter, not the original Scene sort. Beamo normals use observed RSQRTSS capability; external weight volumes, automatic LOD/Visibility, Barn/GPU ownership and complete original classes remain open.

cloud.scope: Original sparse cloud fields and CloudFluffy.vol; CloudCore history/signed depth, three depth passes, 1/8 and 1/4 R16F coarse passes, half-resolution dual RGBA16F CloudFluffy plus dynamic CloudCard, original FogUpsample, MotionGen/MotionDilate/TemporalAa and Tonemap GLSL. Native eight-phase scene and 32-phase half jitter, Gaussian taps and current-jitter correction of previous projection; editor frame clock. Stage-sized viewport uniforms; native top-row depth for AIR FragCoord and explicit lower-left storage for projected Coarse/Fog UV. Shared original environment/weather event bodies and real Wind/extra Marker/cached Rail sampling feed material and cloud motion; prepared ambient/boundary/interaction and native Rail lifecycle remain pending. Camera used for local avatar, original loaded GUID/remap lighting for compatible CloudCards; explicit neutral preview lighting only for unbaked cards, no Visibility occlusion; GPU-resident local Water objects use original OceanMesh and WaterSim shaders, camera-focused grid and zero Avatar contact; FlowerPatch uses original generated texture and point shader in the color/log-depth alpha chain; CPU-readback reference omits Water and Flower draws; fog-volume/bloom/motion-blur inputs zero; recovered transparent color/log-depth outputs use opaque depth and feed FogUpsample, static opaque motion with original temporal resolve; deterministic editor rand31 stream with native conversion, explicit preview composed-HDR geometric-mean exposure and sRGB display transfer. Native opaque RGBA32F converted once to half RTE; transparent targets use explicit RGBA32F preview storage; original per-draw Metal half rounding/game image parity remain unverified.

candles.scope: Original Candle GLSL/body mesh and native-verified whole load/update/render/ignition plus whole Flame.Load operate on shared records. Editor mesh observation/template setup, deterministic rand31, BVH terrain/JS libm, camera/frustum and unoccluded Visibility, scratch/GPU and explicit local audio/effect/notification queues (null audio handles). Resource-ready Candle SetFlame/OnFlame events use the original Barn. Original Flame motion/light prefix and Flame/Candle unload entry bodies run with explicit JS expf/powf and Vertex resource release adapters. Original Initialize/combined mesh owner, Flame interaction/audio remainder and billboards, reward/audio/effect/network dispatch and full GPU/resource lifecycle remain pending.

flowers.scope: Original Flower point GLSL; native-verified RG texture, seed setup, 32-byte generation and whole Update including 300-per-frame growth budget, general pool, LOD/fade/free and mapped vertices. Editor BVH ground tracing/OBB overlap, camera/frustum-only Visibility and GPU map/allocator services use actual terrain/material/first-vertex lighting. FlowerShadow, native collision/spatial jobs/occlusion, complete GPU owner/resource lifecycle and game image acceptance remain pending.
